premise: Snail and Caterpillar race to Deer's hoof; they arrive at exactly the same moment, which takes all afternoon.
inspiration: The Tortoise and the Hare (Aesop), turned: two tortoises and no hare, so nobody loses, and the slowness is the fun.
lesson: Going slowly together is its own kind of winning.

en-US.title: The Slowest Race
en-US.text: {sfx:meadow} {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar came crawling up, {caterpillar:face happy} ripple, ripple. [excited] Let's have a race! {snail:enter} Snail {snail:pulse} said yes, please. {deer:enter} Deer came walking over {deer:pulse} to be the finish line. Ready… steady… GO! [slowly] Caterpillar went {caterpillar:shake 0.3} scrunch… stretch… scrunch… stretch. Snail went {snail:wobble} sliiide… sliiide. Deer waited, and {deer:live hold} bent his head down to nibble the grass. {canvas:clouds 0.5 12s} A cloud floated by. By lunchtime, they were halfway. {caterpillar:live} Caterpillar reared up tall, swayed, and looked for the finish… then down she came, with a happy wiggle. By teatime, Snail {snail:live} tucked into his shell for a rest, waited… then slowly peeked out and looked around. {snail:face surprised} [gasps] Caterpillar {caterpillar:wobble} was right beside him! [giggles] {caterpillar:go to deer} {snail:go to deer} Scrunch, stretch, sliiide… and they touched Deer's hoof at the very same moment. {deer:live resume} Deer lifted his head, flicked his ears and wagged his little tail. {deer:face happy} [happily] It's a tie! {all:face happy} {all:hop} The best race ever, everyone agreed. Even if it did take all afternoon.

es-ES.title: La carrera más lenta
es-ES.text: {sfx:meadow} {caterpillar:enter} Oruga llegó reptando, {caterpillar:face happy} ondula que ondula. [excited] ¡Vamos a hacer una carrera! {snail:enter} Caracol {snail:pulse} dijo que sí. {deer:enter} Ciervo vino caminando {deer:pulse} para ser la meta. Preparados… listos… ¡YA! [slowly] Oruga iba {caterpillar:shake 0.3} encoge… estira… encoge… estira. Caracol iba {snail:wobble} desliiiza… desliiiza. Ciervo esperaba, y {deer:live hold} bajó la cabeza a mordisquear la hierba. {canvas:clouds 0.5 12s} Pasó una nube. A la hora de comer, iban por la mitad. {caterpillar:live} Oruga se estiró bien alta, se balanceó y buscó la meta… y bajó otra vez, meneándose contenta. A la hora de merendar, Caracol {snail:live} se metió en su concha a descansar, esperó… y luego asomó despacito y miró a su alrededor. {snail:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Oruga {caterpillar:wobble} estaba justo a su lado! [giggles] {caterpillar:go to deer} {snail:go to deer} Encoge, estira, desliiiza… y tocaron la pezuña de Ciervo en el mismísimo momento. {deer:live resume} Ciervo levantó la cabeza, movió las orejas y meneó su colita. {deer:face happy} [happily] ¡Empate! {all:face happy} {all:hop} La mejor carrera del mundo, dijeron todos. Aunque durara toda la tarde.

meadow.prompt: a lazy warm afternoon meadow, soft grasshoppers and a faint breeze
